name: Soupape d'admission 993 - proxy F1 et variante titane
description: Proxy parametrique non fonctionnel pour comparer l'encombrement et la masse d'une soupape d'admission 993 de tete 49 mm et queue 8 mm, avec variante Ti-6Al-4V explicitement limitee a la simulation.

classification.intended_use: Simulation de masse, preparation de collision et controle d'encombrement uniquement

provenance.record_license: MIT for code and record; no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: FVD - Dimensions declarees de soupape d'admission 993
sources.notes: Tete 49 mm, queue 8 mm et masse declaree 120 g ; la longueur fonctionnelle exacte reste inconnue.

sources.title: EOS Titanium Ti64 Grade 5
sources.notes: Donnees liees aux machines, jeux de parametres, orientations et traitements EOS ; aucune validation de soupape 993.

post_processing: heat treatment qualified for the exact process
finish machining of stem, tip, groove and seat
surface treatment and polishing to be engineered

titanium.alloy: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 candidate for intake study only
titanium.heat_treatment: to be tied to machine and parameter set; EOS reference recommends stress relief/ductility treatment
titanium.galvanic_isolation: compatibility with guide, seat, retainer and coatings must be reviewed

known_limits: Overall length is a 109 mm hypothesis derived from a 110 mm product envelope.
Keeper groove, seat, margin, neck radius, coating, tolerances and cam/spring dynamics are not defined.
The generated STL is fit-check-only and must never be installed in an engine.
